disclosure.title: Reading recruiter replies
disclosure.body: To sort the email companies send you, Boba uses built-in rules that run on this device first. For messages those rules cannot classify, Boba can ask your agent CLI — matched recruiter email text is then sent to the provider of the model that CLI uses. If your CLI runs a local model, the text stays on this device.
disclosure.hint: You can change this any time in Settings → Privacy → Disclosures.
settings.title: Disclosures

settings.mode_deterministic: Deterministic classification only — nothing leaves this device
settings.auto_confirm: Apply high-confidence Acknowledgements and Rejections automatically
settings.auto_confirm_hint: Off by default. An automatic change is logged and can be undone from Needs you.
